from solution import set_Bit_Number


def test_issue_example_6():
    """Example: set_Bit_Number(6) == 4."""
    result = set_Bit_Number(6)
    expected = 4  # 6 = 4+2 (110), MSB value is 4
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_one():
    """Most significant set bit of 1 (1) is 1."""
    result = set_Bit_Number(1)
    expected = 1  # 1 = 1, MSB value is 1
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_two():
    """Most significant set bit of 2 (10) is 2."""
    result = set_Bit_Number(2)
    expected = 2  # 2 = 2, MSB value is 2
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_three():
    """Most significant set bit of 3 (11) is 2."""
    result = set_Bit_Number(3)
    expected = 2  # 3 = 2+1 (11), MSB value is 2
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_just_below_power_of_two():
    """Most significant set bit of 7 (111) just below 8 is 4."""
    result = set_Bit_Number(7)
    expected = 4  # 7 = 4+2+1 (111), MSB value is 4
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_exact_power_of_two():
    """Most significant set bit of exact power 8 (1000) is 8."""
    result = set_Bit_Number(8)
    expected = 8  # 8 = 8 (1000), MSB value is 8
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_just_above_power_of_two():
    """Most significant set bit of 9 (1001) just above 8 is 8."""
    result = set_Bit_Number(9)
    expected = 8  # 9 = 8+1 (1001), MSB value is 8
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_large_hundred():
    """Most significant set bit of 100 (1100100) is 64."""
    result = set_Bit_Number(100)
    expected = 64  # 100 = 64+32+4 (1100100), MSB value is 64
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_large_boundary_1023():
    """Most significant set bit of 1023 (ten 1s) just below 1024 is 512."""
    result = set_Bit_Number(1023)
    expected = 512  # 1023 = 1024-1, MSB value is 512
    assert result == expected


def test_contract_returns_int():
    """Function returns a set-bit number as an int."""
    result = set_Bit_Number(6)  # 6 = 4+2, MSB value is 4
    assert isinstance(result, int)


def test_contract_result_is_power_of_two():
    """Most significant set bit is a single set bit (power of two)."""
    result = set_Bit_Number(22)  # 22 = 16+4+2 (10110), MSB value is 16
    assert result & (result - 1) == 0


def test_contract_result_bounds_input():
    """Most significant set bit value satisfies result <= n < 2*result."""
    result = set_Bit_Number(10)  # 10 = 8+2 (1010), MSB value is 8; 8 <= 10 < 16
    assert result <= 10 < 2 * result
